messages.content: I have the two Denver hotels in front of me now. Compare the real one-night totals, cancellation, and whether I can leave my bag Friday. I need to get to the workshop without creating a timing issue.

The Holiday Inn Express Denver Downtown is $219.46 including room tax, with no destination charge. Its free-cancellation cutoff is Monday, May 5 at 6:00 p.m. Mountain; after that, the penalty is one night. The hotel beside the workshop is $198 before tax, but a mandatory $25 destination charge plus tax brings the one-night total to $244.31. It can be canceled through Wednesday, May 7 at 6:00 p.m. Mountain.
So the apparent cheaper one is actually $24.85 more?
Correct. The workshop-adjacent hotel is $24.85 more after all mandatory charges. Its advantage is the later cancellation deadline and being next door rather than about a five-minute walk away.
What did you find on the bag? I will check out before the workshop and pick it up around noon.

Holiday Inn Express confirmed complimentary luggage storage for registered guests after checkout. The front desk will tag the carry-on, give you a claim ticket, and hold it until you return around noon. Storage is at the desk, so allow about ten minutes to retrieve it before requesting the airport ride. The adjacent hotel also offers complimentary same-day storage.
And the five-minute walk is realistic with a carry-on Thursday and without it Friday?

Yes. It is roughly four blocks on standard downtown sidewalks, with no transit needed. Friday you can leave the bag at the hotel, walk to the workshop, return at noon, collect it, and depart by rideshare around 12:20 p.m. for the 4:10 p.m. flight.
Choose one. The cancellation difference is not enough by itself to decide this.

Choose the Holiday Inn Express at the confirmed $219.46 mandatory total. The short walk does not interfere with the workshop schedule, post-checkout storage is confirmed, and it keeps the trip estimate at $632.46 and the approval request at $647.46. Book only if the checkout page still shows $219.46 with no added fee and the May 5, 6:00 p.m. Mountain cancellation cutoff. An incidental card hold may still be disclosed at check-in; it is not part of the trip cost.
